catalog_typed_values.name: catalog_typed_values
catalog_typed_values.value: (`catalog_facts`.`region_id` IS NULL OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'city') AND (`catalog_facts`.`cargo_unit_mass_kg` IS NULL OR (`catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'cargo' AND `catalog_facts`.`cargo_unit_mass_kg` >= 0)) AND (`catalog_facts`.`adr_category_id` IS NULL OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'cargo') AND ((`catalog_facts`.`trailer_body_type_id` IS NULL AND `catalog_facts`.`trailer_chain_type_id` IS NULL) OR `catalog_facts`.`kind` = 'trailer_type')

trip_trailer_shape.name: trip_trailer_shape
trip_trailer_shape.value: (`trip_fact_trailers`.`entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_fact_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`source_field` IS NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`unknown_reason` IS NOT NULL) OR (`trip_fact_trailers`.`entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`source_field` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_fact_trailers`.`unknown_reason` IS NULL)

trip_fact_origin_shape.name: trip_fact_origin_shape
trip_fact_origin_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`origin_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_fact_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`origin_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`origin_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_destination_shape.name: trip_fact_destination_shape
trip_fact_destination_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`destination_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_fact_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`destination_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`destination_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_cargo_shape.name: trip_fact_cargo_shape
trip_fact_cargo_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`cargo_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_fact_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`cargo_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_adr_shape.name: trip_fact_adr_shape
trip_fact_adr_shape.value: (`trip_facts`.`adr_entity_id` IS NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_fact_id` IS NULL) OR (`trip_facts`.`adr_entity_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`adr_fact_id` IS NOT NULL AND `trip_facts`.`catalog_revision_id` IS NOT NULL)

trip_fact_quantities.name: trip_fact_quantities
trip_fact_quantities.value: (`trip_facts`.`cargo_mass_kg` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`cargo_mass_kg` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`actual_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`actual_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`measured_segment_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`measured_segment_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`planned_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`planned_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`delivered_distance_m` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`delivered_distance_m` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`fuel_used_l` IS NULL OR `trip_facts`.`fuel_used_l` >= 0) AND (`trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` IS NULL OR (`trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` >= 0 AND `trip_facts`.`cargo_damage_fraction` <= 1))
